rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is setting for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a situation and something that situation is a setting for.

rdf:Description.swrl:argument2: A step cannot need a resource that will be produced by a following step

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has error
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A kind of error resulting from a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: workflow
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A sequence of connected steps, representing a sequence of publishing operations undertaken by agents. A workflow may be seen as an abstract model of real work.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Publishing Workflow Ontology (PWO)
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Aldo Gangemi (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5568-2684)
David Shotton (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5506-523X)
Silvio Peroni (https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Publishing Workflow Ontology (PWO)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Gangemi, A., Peroni, S., Shotton, D., Vitali, F. (2014). The Publishing Workflow Ontology (PWO). In Semantic Web, 8 (5): 703-718. DOI: https://doi.org/10.3233/SW-160230. Open Access at: http://www.semantic-web-journal.net/system/files/swj1301.pdf
rdf:Description.vann:changes: * **v2.5.0**: added new documentation, including annotation properties (e.g., `bibo:doi`, `schema:codeRepository`, etc.), term properties (e.g., `vann:example`, `vs:term_status`, etc.), exemplary competency questions with their respective SPARQL queries, and a Grafoo diagram.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time interval
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Two (starting and ending) points in time that define a particular period of time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is executed by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a workflow description and the related workflow execution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: satisfies
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a situation and a description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has first step
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a workflow and its first step.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: happened
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an event and the interval when it happened.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: workflow execution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The aggregate of actions executed in the steps defined in a workflow.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has next step
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a step in a workflow and the step that directly follows it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is produced by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between something and the workflow step or an event (e.g. an action executing a workflow step) that produces, creates or results in that thing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: step
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An atomic unit of a workflow, that may be characterized by a starting time and an ending time, and may be associated with one or more events. A workflow step usually involves some input information, material or energy needed to complete the step, and some output information, material or energy produced by that step. In the case of a publishing workflow, a step typically results in the creation of a publication entity, usually by the modification of another pre-existing publication entity, e.g. the creation of an edited paper from a rough draft, or of an HTML representation from an XML mark-up.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has step
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a workflow and a component step.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: object
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any physical, social, or mental object, or substance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An event that may happen during a publishing process, such as writing a draft, sending a preprint, publishing a paper, etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This property allows to link a workflow execution to the related workflow description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has participant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an event and an object participating in that event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: satisfies
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a description and a situation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: produces
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a workflow step or an event (e.g. an action executing a workflow step) and the thing that the step/event produces, creates or results in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has previous step
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a step in a workflow and the step that directly precedes it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: task
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A piece of work to be done or undertaken.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: involves action
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a particular execution of a workflow and an action.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: at time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A time interval during which something is happening.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A view on a set of entities. It can be seen as a 'relational context', reifying a relation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: time indexed situation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A situation that is explicitly indexed at some time for at least one entity.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: action
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An event with at least one agent participating in it, and that executes a task.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is task defined in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a task and its description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has parameter
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a concept and a parameter.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: defines task
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between a description and a task.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: action
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An event with at least one agent that is participant in it and that is linked to a workflow execution and to a step of the related workflow description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executes task
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an action and a task.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has time indexed setting
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an entity and a time-indexed situation it is involved in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is step of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a step in a workflow and the workflow of which it is a component.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is executed in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a task and an action.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: action
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An event with at least one agent that participates in it, and that executes a task.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duration description
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Description of temporal extent structured with separate values for the various elements of a calendar-clock system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: needs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a workflow step or an event (e.g. an action executing a workflow step) and anything required to undertake that step/event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is needed by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a thing required to undertake a workflow step or an event (e.g. an action executing a workflow step) and the step/event itself.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: plan execution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An event with at least one agent participating in it, and that executes a task.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: plan
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A description having an explicit goal to be achieved by executing tasks.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directly follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The intransitive follows relation. For example, Wednesday directly precedes Thursday. Directness of precedence depends on the designer conceptualization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is interval for
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an interval describing when an event happened and the related event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: for entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a time-indexed situation and an entity involved in it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: precedes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relation between entities, expressing a 'sequence' schema. E.g. 'year 1999 precedes 2000', 'deciding what coffee to use' precedes 'preparing coffee', 'World War II follows World War I', 'in the Milan to Rome autoroute, Bologna precedes Florence', etc. It can then be used between tasks, processes, time intervals, spatially locate objects, situations, etc. Subproperties can be defined in order to distinguish the different uses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has participant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an event and an object participating in that event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directly precedes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The intransitive precedes relation. For example, Monday directly precedes Tuesday. Directness of precedence depends on the designer conceptualization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is action involved in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an event and a particular execution of a workflow description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has interval date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A date value assigned to a time interval.
